question: The Fourth Schedule of the Constitution of India contains the subject matter related to:

options.text: power, authority and responsibilities of panchayats
allocation of seats in the Rajya Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**allocation of seats in the Rajya Sabha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Fourth Schedule of the Indian constitution deals with the Allocation of seats in the Rajya Sabha to the states and the union territories.
 
• It corresponds with article 4 and article 80 of the constitution.
